description: Test suite for WebSocket frame header encoding, masking, and opcode validation in the net namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a WebSocket frame, including opcode, payload length, masking, and reserved bits.

classes.name: WebSocketMaskingKey
classes.description: Contains the masking key used for WebSocket frame payload masking.

methods.name: WriteWebSocketFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes a WebSocketFrameHeader into a buffer, optionally applying masking.

methods.name: MaskWebSocketFramePayload
methods.description: Applies or removes masking on WebSocket frame payload data using a masking key and frame offset.
